card.name: Short prepositions in general web text
card.fires_on: Small words like "in", "In", "of", "de", "From" in non-drug web text, often right after a sentence break or a name. Also partway through some foreign surnames.

modes.label: In / From at a phrase start
modes.description: The word "in" or "In" or "From" opens a clause or follows a noun in general prose.
modes.example: extend to every part of the globe.<< In>> the past century the Church has grown both

modes.label: Inside names
modes.description: A connector or name piece inside a person's or a title's name.
modes.example: Etienne<< de>> Fougères derided lesbians in his

card.plain: It fires on little linking words like "in" and "of" in ordinary web prose, not in drug-label text.
